| Field | Value | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| IPv4 | 172.17.0.99 | Consistent source of all suspicious flows; only non-infrastructure LAN host |

## Malware family

**Attribution: behavioral, not signature-confirmed.** No IDS/Suricata alerts were provided with this capture, so the name below is inferred purely from traffic behavior, not a signature match.

The host runs a **pay-per-install-style loader/bot**. Behavioral signals:

- Beacons every ~70-90 seconds (48 check-ins across the capture) via HTTP POST to a bare IP (no DNS lookup ever precedes it) at `/foots.php`, sending small encrypted/binary blobs (`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`) and getting trivial `200 text/html` acks back.

This bot-ID/subid/gate-URL check-in structure is characteristic of pay-per-install loader infrastructure (PrivateLoader-style), used to install additional payloads for paying affiliates.
- The C2 IP is never resolved via DNS in this capture, consistent with a hardcoded C2 address baked into the loader.
